decision: No profile passed all fixed safeguards
physical_definition: Two conservative transport branches with fixed humidity profile. Lower dry-mass fraction eta=.25 (ground pressure to .75*surface pressure), upper specific-humidity ratio r=.1/.2/.3. With lower flow Ul (including fixed1km thermal shear) and projected stationary dry-column Ub, upper=(Ub-eta*Ul)/(1-eta). Dry mass weighted sum exactly Ub; water fractions eta/[eta+(1-eta)r] and remainder. Sum separate directional upwind fluxes and operators; do not upwind averaged velocity. Same branch faces in residual and boundary ledgers. Total W remains a single state: implicit instantaneous redistribution to a fixed vertical profile, no resolved vertical thermodynamics/momentum. Separate-branch upwinding adds resolution-dependent first-order mixing, not measured physical eddy diffusivity. Surface heat/lift/evaporation retain surface winds; no observed winds as forcing. Fixed hydrostatic M and flat-grid geometry remain approximations.
scope: Publish all outcomes and separate-branch transport limitations. No adoption without all existing Earth/full31/ocean/fine/established6 and matched-world gates. Keep current headline scores and normal atlas climate/economics until qualified. New source/output epoch; preserve old failures. Do not interpret first-order counterflow mixing as a fitted physical diffusivity.
